text:
@article{Hinton2012-ab,
  title         = "{Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors}",
  author        = "Hinton, Geoffrey E and Srivastava, Nitish and Krizhevsky, Alex",
  journal       = "arXiv [cs.NE]",
  year          =  2012,
  month         =  jul,
  eprint        = "1207.0580",
  archivePrefix = "arXiv",
  primaryClass  = "cs.NE",
  keywords      = "ml;dropout",
  file          = "All Papers/H/Hinton et al. 2012 - Improving neural networks.pdf"
}
note: Paperpile export with arXiv eprint, month macro and file path
Google Scholar export: booktitle becomes the venue
LaTeX accents in braces become Unicode; protective braces go
publisher stands in as venue and stays in fields; unknown macros keep their letters
corporate authors in braces are kept; others; eprinttype; doi URL prefix removed
upper-case names; \H and \' accents; note becomes notes
a } in the key ends the entry before its fields, so the entry has no title and is dropped
@string macros, case-insensitive, with # concatenation; year from the first four digits
@comment and @preamble are not entries

text:
@comment{@article{inside, title = {Found inside a comment}}}
@misc{after, title = {After}}
note: scanning continues inside @comment, so an entry there is read
parenthesised entry; First Last names flip
entries without a title are dropped, even with an empty one; a missing key is kept as empty
whitespace collapses; \emph unwraps; escaped specials
accents without braces, \i, \ss, \o, \AE, \l, cedilla
keywords split on , and ; with identifiers dropped
arXiv ids from url, arxivid and bare eprints; old-style eprint without prefix stays in fields
a later field replaces an earlier one

text:
@article{malformed,
  title = {Survives},
  this is not a field,
  = {no name},
  volume = 7,
  note
}
note: malformed fields are skipped
editor stands in only when there is no author field

text:
@article{annote, title = {Annote}, annote = {my notes}, note = {publisher note}}
@article{emptyfields, title = {Empty}, abstract = {}, doi = {}, url = {}, file = {}, journal = {}}
note: annote wins over note; empty abstract, doi and venue are absent but empty url and file are kept

text: @article{quoted, title = "A {"}quoted{"} word and {braced "quote"}", author = "O'Neil, Cathy"}
note: quotes inside braces do not end a quoted value

text: @article{nested, title = {Outer {Inner {Deepest}} back}, journal = {J. {\"O}sterr.}}
note: nested braces
year: first four digits as a number, even 0; no digits means absent

empty text

text: @article{k, title={Kept}, junk here, year = 1999, note={also kept}}

text:
@article{k, title={Kept}, = {x}, year = 1999}
@book{b, title={Next entry}}
note: a malformed field skipped to a } ends the entry; the next entry is read

note: Unicode whitespace (no-break space, line separator, ideographic space, BOM) counts as whitespace

text: @article{k, title={ABC}}

text: @article{k, title={From a URL}, url={HTTPS://ARXIV.ORG/ABS/2106.09685V3}}

text: @article{k, title={From a PDF URL}, url={https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.09685v2.PDF}}
